rationale.org-governance: Integrates versioned controls, audit, policy, roles, and change management.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Versions prompts, bindings, outputs, checks, and reviewer decisions for replay.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides citations, traces, counterfactuals, and evidence views for reviewer judgment.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Integrates tests, linters, detectors, filters, and CI verification passes.
rationale.risk-routing: Independent thresholds and risk labels trigger selective human or organizational escalation.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines PR/CI sign-offs and reviewer authority to accept or reject outputs.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps interaction-time records and escalation to external risk-based transparency expectations.
rationale.lit-review: Rapid review synthesizes forty studies into capabilities, controls, and guidance.
rationale.framework: Specifies reusable capability, control, reporting, and pipeline-integration architecture.
rationale.design-only: Buildable schemas, thresholds, blueprints, and I/O contracts remain unimplemented.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes treating prompt-layer governance as sufficient for model-level harms.
rationale.steering: Main controls bind prompts, context, retrieval, and generation constraints.
rationale.metrics: Defines operational measures for quality, compliance, privacy, bias, and ip-plagiarism.
rationale.risk-security: Mitigates adversarial, vulnerability, and unsafe-code risks through checks and escalation.
rationale.risk-quality: Treats factuality, specification adherence, and output utility as focal risks.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Analyzes prompt overreach and measures reviewer accuracy, overrides, and trust calibration.
rationale.risk-ip: Specifies license detection, attribution checks, provenance, and legal escalation.
rationale.risk-bias: Specifies fairness controls, parity thresholds, monitoring, and escalation beyond prompting.
